transcript.content:
Hello AI Assistant, 

Could you please draft a response to the vendor's invoice email using our standard payment-timeline message? I want to ensure they know when to expect processing. Thank you! 

Best,  
[Your Name]

Sure — I can draft that. Below is a concise, professional reply using a standard payment-timeline message. If you’d like, I can send it for you — tell me the vendor email (or point me to the invoice email) and whether to send now or schedule.

Draft reply:

Subject: Re: Invoice [invoice number if available]

Hello [Vendor Name],

Thank you — we have received your invoice. We will begin processing it within 3 business days and expect payment to be issued in accordance with our standard terms (payment to be completed within 30 days of receipt), unless otherwise agreed. If you need an estimated payment date or have a different payment-term arrangement, please let me know and I will confirm.

If you can, please reply with the invoice number and any supporting documents/reference numbers to help us match it in our system.

Thanks,
[Your Name]
[Your Title, optional]
company.com
[phone number, optional]

Would you like me to:
- Replace placeholders (vendor name, invoice number, your signature) and send this now? If so, tell me which invoice or vendor email to reply to.
- Or just save this draft in your Drafts folder?
Please replace the placeholders and send it now to the vendor's email provided in the original invoice. Thank you! [END]
